text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Moroccan-European Union joint commission accepts Moroccan proposal for biological rest period of four months in 1997 for cephalopods to allow stocks to recover. Rest period will be split between March/April and September/October.
- Private TV channel 2M which has been taken over by the state will start wider operations accessible to everyone on Friday.
- Moroccan President of Organisation of Islamic Conference Azeddine Laraki says King Hassan brought seal of moderation to the organisation.
- Moroccan-American Trade and Investment Council launches information web site on Internet.
- World Bank report on Morocco which disclosed weaknesses of economic sector and ways to tackle them, stressed need for trade reform, a law on competitiveness and a new labour code.
- Heavy rains damage vegetable crops, planting will be stopped until weather is better.
